= Image pdfwidth
:dimension-image: inline-image-dimensions.svg
:pdfwidth: 40pt

== Block images

No local dimensions; the document attribute does not provide a default:

image::{dimension-image}[Document attribute only]

Generic positional width, 40px:

image::{dimension-image}[Generic positional,40]

Generic named width, 40px:

image::{dimension-image}[Generic named,width=40]

PDF width, 40pt:

image::{dimension-image}[PDF points,pdfwidth=40]

PDF width overrides generic width:

image::{dimension-image}[Precedence,width=40,pdfwidth=60]

Generic percentage, capped at the content width:

image::{dimension-image}[Generic percentage,width=200%]

PDF percentage, allowed to exceed the content width:

image::{dimension-image}[PDF percentage,pdfwidth=200%]

Generic unit-suffixed width is ignored:

image::{dimension-image}[Generic units,width=40px]

PDF width accepts CSS pixels:

image::{dimension-image}[PDF pixels,pdfwidth=40px]

PDF width accepts physical units:

image::{dimension-image}[PDF inches,pdfwidth=1in]

PDF width can scale the intrinsic width:

image::{dimension-image}[Intrinsic ratio,pdfwidth=50iw]

PDF width can use the page width:

image::{dimension-image}[Viewport ratio,pdfwidth=50vw]

An invalid PDF width still overrides the generic width:

image::{dimension-image}[Invalid PDF width,width=40,pdfwidth=bogus]

== Inline images

No local dimensions: before image:{dimension-image}[Document attribute only] after.

Generic positional width: before image:{dimension-image}[Generic positional,40] after.

Generic named width: before image:{dimension-image}[Generic named,width=40] after.

PDF width: before image:{dimension-image}[PDF points,pdfwidth=40] after.

PDF width overrides generic width: before image:{dimension-image}[Precedence,width=40,pdfwidth=60] after.

Generic oversized percentage: before image:{dimension-image}[Generic percentage,width=200%] after.

PDF oversized percentage: before image:{dimension-image}[PDF percentage,pdfwidth=200%] after.

Generic unit-suffixed width: before image:{dimension-image}[Generic units,width=40px] after.

PDF width in CSS pixels: before image:{dimension-image}[PDF pixels,pdfwidth=40px] after.

PDF width in inches: before image:{dimension-image}[PDF inches,pdfwidth=1in] after.

PDF intrinsic ratio: before image:{dimension-image}[Intrinsic ratio,pdfwidth=50iw] after.

Inline PDF viewport units fall back to points: before image:{dimension-image}[Viewport fallback,pdfwidth=50vw] after.

Invalid PDF width: before image:{dimension-image}[Invalid PDF width,width=40,pdfwidth=bogus] after.
